Pgp has a large, flexible drug-binding pocket within the transmembrane domain that can accommodate structurally diverse substrates and inhibitors. Features associated with non-inhibitors: low lipophilicity (logP < 2) — highly polar, hydrophilic molecules do not partition into the membrane to reach the binding site. Small molecular weight (< 300 Da) — compact molecules tend not to fill the large binding cavity effectively. Few aromatic rings (0-1).
